messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] spike detected: fncall/structured-output error rate and CPU on inference-pool-usw2-03 — 9.6x baseline, 65% of requests now failing with 50x increased p95 latency. Auto-escalation to oncall.

maya: paging oncall — seeing queue backlog and OOMs on the tool-executor group. Root traces show heavy KV cache churn when structured/json outputs requested.

lee: confirmed in logs — generator pods hitting CUDNN OOM and slowdowns on quantized kernels. This is saturating hot shards, affects tool/fncall paths only. Embeddings + vanilla generations look fine.

samir: ok — immediate mitigation options? can we do a soft-squelch instead of full shutdown so integrators degrade gracefully.

natalie: customer-facing impact: third-party agents using function-calling are getting partial responses or 5xx. Several mid-market tenants on Dedicated reported retries. Need to limit damage and notify customers if we change behavior.

maya: plan A: apply per-tenant soft-rate-limit for fncalls (50% reduction) + disable structured JSON output streaming for free tier only; keep plain-text fallback. This should reduce KV churn.

lee: I can push the routing rule for structured_output:false for free-tier route in ~3min. Command I’ll run:
```
rictl routing add-rule --match-tier free --set structured_output=false --priority 800 --reason "mitigate fncall surge 225888"
```

samir: also recommend lowering per-request max_fn_invokes to 2 globally for 15m. That will stop long agent loops. CLI:
```
rictl config set global.max_fn_invokes 2 --ttl 900
```

natalie: please prepare a short customer blurb. We should call out degraded agent features and suggest text-only fallback. I'll draft: "We're temporarily attenuating function/tool calling and structured JSON streaming to stabilize latency. If your app relies on function calls, consider falling back to plain text until we clear backlog."

maya: I’m going to carve a mitigation ticket and execute canary on us-west first. @lee coordinate on log hooks so we can watch failure decrease.

lee: starting canary now on pool inference-pool-usw2-03 -> applying routing rule.

ops-bot: Action started: routing rule applied to free-tier routes in us-west-2 (rule id r-8c3). Monitoring 5m window.

maya: observing immediate drop in CPU wait and KV churn on canary shard. Error rate down ~40% on canary. Good signal.

samir: roll to global with tiered approach: free -> low -> medium over 10m windows. We should avoid touching enterprise tenants right now unless necessary.

natalie: sent customer note to affected list (APIs + Dedicated) with workaround and ETA 2h. Pinged AE leads.

lee: rolling to low tier now. running global config change to max_fn_invokes = 2 with TTL. Applying:
```
rictl config set global.max_fn_invokes 2 --scope low --ttl 900
```

incident-bot: [UPDATE] mitigation in progress: structured output disabled for free-tier, max_fn_invokes reduced for free+low. Observed reduction in p95 by ~30% across routed shards.

maya: ops, please keep an eye on synthetic evals and the model-fallback telemetry. If latency hits SLO again, fallback to text-mode for medium tier as well.

samir: noted. I'll stay on until stabilization and then hand off to night oncall @samir (self-handoff) at 23:00 PST. leaving a runbook pointer: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/mitigate-fncall-surge

natalie: will update status page with "degraded agent/function-calling" and link to support playbook.

ops-bot: Monitoring window complete: canary -> success. Error rate trending down. Will proceed with staggered rollout.

maya: after 25m of rollout, overall system CPU/latency back to acceptable margins. Still seeing a few noisy tenants; created tenant-quarantine ticket for one noisy app.

lee: for postmortem, capture stack traces of OOM kernels and the KV cache eviction patterns. We might need a kernel fallback for quantized paths.

samir: handoff note: mitigation applied, oncall will monitor for 2h. If errors creep above 10% of baseline, escalate to eng-runtime. Contact list: maya, lee, samir. I've set a watch in PagerDuty for +2h.

natalie: customer comms sent and support triage open. Will follow up with impacted AE leads.

maya: leaving thread. thanks all. :thumbsup:

samir: taking over monitoring. will post any anomalous spikes or rollback events here.
